campos.#message: Hi Future Associate team, I am applying for the 3D Generalist role. I am a Senior 3D Artist with more than ten years covering the pipeline end to end: modelling, sculpting, retopology, UVs, baking, texturing and look development, plus lighting and rendering on the delivery side, and grooming in Houdini. For almost five years I have been with E-Line Media in Arizona, taking Endstar's hero assets from first sculpt to engine. Before that I modeled and hand-painted the characters for The Wingfeather Saga season 1 at Angel Studios, working to brief and to deadline with revision rounds as routine, which is the same working relationship film and television delivery asks for. Earlier I spent three years at PUGA Studios delivering assets under another studio's art direction in the client's defined style. Tools: Maya, ZBrush, Substance Painter and Designer, Houdini, Marmoset, Unreal and Unity. My portfolio holds more than 45 projects with over 60 characters across many titles, and my personal projects are some of the strongest pieces in it. There is no attachment field here, so the showreel link above is my ArtStation, and my CV and a portfolio PDF are available on request. Two things you should know up front rather than later. I am currently in Olinda, and I am not an Australian citizen or permanent resident, so I would need visa sponsorship. I want to relocate to Sydney and I am fully open to moving for the role; my academic background, with an honors laurea, a postgraduate specialization in Game Art, a master's in progress, IELTS and publications, makes a strong visa case. ArtStation: artstation.com/viniciuscavalcanti | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/vinicavalcnti. Thank you for your time. Vini Cavalcanti
